title: "Brain virome catalog and atlas"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# load libraries
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
source(here::here("src/parse_sample_id.R"))
library(forcats)
```


Load and parse metadata
```{r}
meta_pil_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/samples/brain_pilot_fmt_pools_metadata.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      grepl("-A", sample_ID) ~ "bulk DNA",
      grepl("-B", sample_ID) ~ "host depleted DNA",
      grepl("-C", sample_ID) ~ "bulk RNA",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(tissue = gsub("Brain tissue/", "", sample_description)) |>
  filter(condition %in% c("bulk DNA", "other")) #only look at hybrid capture DNA for this

meta_hvp_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/samples/brain_hvp_fmt_pools_metadata.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(tissue = gsub("Brain DNA - ", "", sample_description)) |>
  filter(note == "brain_dna_capture") #only look at hybrid capture DNA for this

meta_dt <- rbind(
  meta_pil_dt |> select(c(sample_ID, Pool, tissue)),
  meta_hvp_dt |> select(c(sample_ID, Pool, tissue))
)
```

load tax tables
```{r}
tax_file_list <- c(
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p2055.tax_profile.tsv"),
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p2058.tax_profile.tsv"),
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p2059.tax_profile.tsv"),
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p1733.tax_profile.tsv"),
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p1849.tax_profile.tsv"),
  here::here("data/tax_profiles/esviritu_p1894.tax_profile.tsv")
)


esv_tax_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(tax_file_list, fread))

esv_tax_dt <- esv_tax_dt |>
  filter(
    read_count >= 10,
    !genus %in% c(
      "g__Betacoronavirus", "g__Gammaretrovirus", "g__Respirovirus",
      "g__Lentivirus", "g__Alphacoronavirus", "g__Orthorubulavirus",
      "g__Enterovirus"
      ),
    !species %in% c(
      "s__Betapapillomavirus 1", "s__Betapapillomavirus 2", 
      "s__Betapapillomavirus 3", "s__Human papillomavirus",
      "s__Triatovirus nigereginacellulae", "s__Lepidopteran ambidensovirus 1",
      "s__Scythevirus dianchis", "s__Blattambidensovirus incertum1", 
      "s__Pigeon aviadenovirus B", "s__Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae"
      ),
    !grepl("s__unclassified", species)
    ) |>
  separate(sample_ID, c("sample_ID", "Pool"), sep = "[.]") 
```

```{r}
esv_tax_dt |>
  distinct(species)
```



merge metadata and tax profiles
```{r}
merge_dt <- merge(
  esv_tax_dt,
  meta_dt,
  by = c("sample_ID", "Pool"),
  all.y = T
) |>
  filter(!grepl("CMMR", sample_ID)) # remove controls
```

```{r}
heatmap2_p <- merge_dt |>
  mutate(
    species = gsub("^s__", "", species),
    family = gsub("^f__", "", family)
    ) |>
  complete(nesting(sample_ID, tissue), nesting(species, family), fill = list(RPKMF=0)) |>
  group_by(species, family, sample_ID, tissue) |>
  summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) |>
  filter(!is.na(tissue), !is.na(family)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(species) |>
  filter(sum(RPKMF != 0) >= 3) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = sample_ID,
    y = fct_reorder(species, RPKMF, .fun = function(x) sum(x != 0), .desc = FALSE),
    fill = log10(RPKMF)
  )) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#f5dfbc",
    mid = "orange",
    high = "purple",
    na.value = "white",
    midpoint = -1
    #limits = c(1, NA)
  ) +
  facet_grid(c(~family, ~tissue),
             scales = "free",
             space = "free"
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Brain Specimens",
    y = "Virus Species",
    fill = "log10(RPKMF)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x =element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) 

heatmap2_p
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  here::here("charts/brain_virome_atlas_heatmap1.pdf"),
  heatmap2_p,
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)
```
